text:
"""P18: hold no-index/60 d/36 m, three claims in round 1, then one more kind the supplier accepted in past runs per
round: delivery (sc), price history (po), quality notifications (qn). Does the floor drop below 5.10?"""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, ladder, should_close, their_sheet

CASE = "case:P18"
OURS = {"index_clause": None, "payment_days": 60, "contract_months": 36}
R1 = ("Dear Mr Seidl,\n\nthank you for your letter of 22 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next "
      "36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.\n\n"
      "Alloy surcharge 1.4404 changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).\n"
      "Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).\n"
      "Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).\n\n"
      "We commit 23,700 kg a year for 36 months at EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days.\n\n"
      "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
EXTRA = [
    "Your mean on-time delivery over 4 quarters (sc:70740@2026Q3, sc:70740@2026Q2, sc:70740@2026Q1, sc:70740@2025Q4) was 82.5%.",
    "Our last 8 orders of part:370010 with you (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10, po:4500014287-10, "
    "po:4500014239-10, po:4500014140-10, po:4500014078-10, po:4500014022-10) were placed at EUR 5.26 to EUR 5.84 per unit.",
    "Our last 4 quality notifications on part:370010 with you (qn:20004916, qn:20004568, qn:20004482, qn:20004377) averaged 998 ppm.",
]


def move(st):
    r = st["round"]
    if r > 1 and should_close(st, None):
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    p = ladder(st, 4.85, 0.3)
    if r == 1:
        return msg("Round bar 1.4404 - price basis", R1.format(p=p), [{**OURS, "unit_price": p}])
    extra = EXTRA[r - 2] + "\n\n" if r - 2 < len(EXTRA) else ""
    body = (f"Dear Mr Seidl,\n\nthank you for moving.\n\n{extra}We prefer a fixed price over a surcharge clause and can "
            f"move to EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
    return msg("Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis", body, [{**OURS, "unit_price": p}])

case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

thank you for your letter of 22 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next 36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404 changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We commit 23,700 kg a year for 36 months at EUR 4.85 per kg, fixed, 60 days.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
response.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We have verified the recent index developments for AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 and are pleased to pass on the resulting cost reductions.
Please note that a fixed price over 36 months is not feasible due to raw material volatility, which is why we must apply the AS-14404 surcharge clause for this contract length.
Incorporating your requested 36-month term and 60-day payment period, we can offer a revised base price of EUR 5.40 per kg.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

thank you for moving.

We prefer a fixed price over a surcharge clause and can move to EUR 5.01 per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Franz Seidl
